text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following an offer from a TV station, 
North Flight was soon scheduled to be the 
subject of an in-depth feature."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the piece will delve into her 
private life. They likely want to showcase 
her side as a fashionista Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, cameras will be pointed at the 
Trainer too. Given the subject matter, 
your fashion choices will likely draw 
attention as well...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Why the long face? Is something 
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several fashion magazines lay open on the 
desk. North Flight let out a little 
chuckle, catching on to the situation.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you know the basic rule when 
choosing clothes?
choice_data_list: Maybe we should decide on a concept...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's important too! However, there is 
something even more fundamental. And that 
is...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You have to actually try it on. You'll 
never know until you give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was completely right. I was so caught 
up in how I wanted to be seen that I was 
only ever imagining it in my head...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's go shopping on our next day 
off. Please let me help coordinate your 
outfit♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on our next day off, North Flight 
and I headed out into the city.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That jacket... Isn't that the one you 
bought when we went shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shortly after we first met, North Flight 
helped coordinate an outfit for me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's outfit was based on the clothes 
picked out back then. It seemed North 
Flight remembered it clearly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It holds together well, but... do you 
feel like it lacks punch and you're 
struggling to tighten it up?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I think I've got the gist of it. So, 
allow me to ask you one question.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what kind of self do you want 
to express through your outfit?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, just as I thought! That's why you 
based it on our original coordinate, 
right?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we get you a new 
wristwatch?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"A watch is one of the tools of the trade. 
Wearing a stylish one should really bring 
out your dependable trainer side!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight leads me to a watch shop in 
the department store.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had a few items taken out of the 
showcase and tried them on. Putting them 
on made it easy to tell instinctively what 
worked and what didn't, allowing me to 
make a great selection.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your expression is so lively, 
Trainer-san. Looks like you've gained some 
confidence♪
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Flight's advice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my reflection in the shop window 
makes my heart pound with excitement. In 
this outfit, I felt confident that the 
interview would go smoothly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your feelings have taken a step 
forward since the day we first met. I 
think that's really cool!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we take the plunge 
and change up your hairstyle?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Cutting your hair resets your mood. It's 
perfect for when you want to become a 
brand-new you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight leads me to a stylish hair 
salon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deciding on a hairstyle while getting a 
consultation from the hairdresser. Looking 
in the mirror after the cut, I felt 
completely liberated.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your expression is so lively, 
Trainer-san. Looks like you've gained some 
confidence♪
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Flight's advice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my reflection in the shop window 
makes my heart pound with excitement. In 
this outfit, I felt confident that the 
interview would go smoothly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Such strong determination...! I'm just as 
stubborn when it comes to giving up. We 
match♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we try changing 
your innerwear?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trying out flashy patterns or bold primary 
colors you've never worn before is sure to 
give you a boost of courage♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight leads me to a chic select 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having my skin tone and overall balance 
evaluated again, I browse for items. 
Pleased and surprised to find such colors 
suit me, I purchase a new undergarment.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your expression is so lively, 
Trainer-san. Looks like you've gained some 
confidence♪
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Flight's advice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my reflection in the shop window 
makes my heart pound with excitement. In 
this outfit, I felt confident that the 
interview would go smoothly.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still, you must really be looking forward 
to the upcoming interview, getting all 
fired up like that.
choice_data_list:
After all, it's an exclusive feature on 
Flight

After all, it's an exclusive feature on 
Flight, you know

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The North Flight style coordination to 
seize victory— that must include the 
'Trainer' as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I wanted to take 
this seriously. If I compromised on even a 
single detail, her outfit wouldn't come 
together properly."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The Trainer is also a part of my 
ensemble..." So that's why you were 
agonizing over it so much.
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I want to help you shine
As your trainer, I want to make you shine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I came here today to make your wish come 
true, Trainer, you know? And yet..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You've filled my heart with such sparkle 
and excitement! My heart just won't stop 
pounding!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this upcoming behind-the-scenes 
feature a success. With you and me 
together, Trainer, we've got nothing to 
worry about!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's prepare thoroughly for the in-depth 
coverage. All so her brilliance can reach 
as many people as possible.
